verdict.rationale: Airwallex's spend-management AI applies the customer's own spend rules automatically as an always-on check on expense reports. It also auto-routes bills for approval after filling accounting fields. This is a narrow, domain-specific form of user-defined rules triggering automatic actions, not a general event-to-action rule engine. Webhooks are only an outbound notification building block and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a general user-configurable rule/trigger builder across events (payments, payouts, FX, cards), documentation of which actions rules can trigger and how rules are defined, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Always-on checks to audit reports and apply your spend rules automatically, without slowing employees down.
Simply attach your bill, then watch AI fill out accounting fields before routing it for approval.
